title: Forklift Operator | Leading Steel Manufacturer | Early Finish Fridays + Ongoing
summary:
Join a leading steel manufacturer as a forklift operator, supporting picking, packing, loading and replenishment within a great warehouse team based in Pinkenba.

You won’t be thrown in the deep end here! Our team will guide you onsite, showing you how everything works and helping you build confidence step by step

Regular set hours
Mon – Thurs: 6:00am – 2:30pm
Fri: 6:00am – 12:30pm – start your weekend early ��

Why Join Us?

Be part of a dynamic team in a growing industry
Supportive, hands-on work environment
Well above award wages
Ongoing Full time hours work
Key Responsibilities

Operate forklifts safely to load and unload steel products
Accurately pick orders ready for dispatch
Replenishments – putting stock away in correct locations
Work as part of a team with a positive, can-do attitude
Requirements:

Valid forklift licence (Counterbalance essential)
Experience operating forklifts and handling long/heavy loads
Previous warehouse or manufacturing experience preferred
Physically fit with good attention to detail
Team player with a strong focus on safety

title: Warehouse Operators
summary:
We’re Hiring: High Reach Forklift Operators | Richlands 
Morning Shift | Ongoing Work

Join a nationally recognised company that’s growing like crazy! We’re on the lookout for skilled High Reach Forklift Operators to jump into an awesome team based at a state-of-the-art facility in Richlands.

 Shift: Monday to Friday, 5:30am – 1:36pm
Reliable Transport needed for early shift start!
 PPE Required: Hi-vis (vest or polo), steel caps – standard safety gear

 ✅ What You’ll Need:
- Current Forklift Licence
- At least 12 months' experience on High Reach (Jungheinrich or Yale experience is a bonus!)
- A good team vibe – you'll be working closely with others

✅ What You’ll Be Doing:
- Driving High Reach Forklifts (Jungheinrich & Yale)
- Picking and packing orders
- Loading containers for dispatch
- Working hand-in-hand with the Manufacturing team
- Being part of a tight-knit crew

✅ Perks of the Job:
- Work in a modern, purpose-built warehouse
- Easy location in Richlands with plenty of free onsite parking
- Break room with free coffee machine, food vending machines & big screen TVs
- Designated smokers area
